description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class, which handles database interactions related to employee attendance records in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. The tests verify retrieval of latest attendance records and attendance records within specified date ranges.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao, testing retrieval of attendance records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data from fixture.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests fetching the latest attendance record for a specific employee number.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance records within specific date ranges for a given employee.
